name: links
title: Link poses
description: One row per t × run × situation: each link's pose, from the producer's forward kinematics (the card only poses it). Per link, <link>_x / _y / _z (its origin, in the scene's unit, declared in the producer's sidecar) and <link>_qw / _qx / _qy / _qz (unitless): scene3d.robot's columns as built.

fields.name: t
fields.description: seconds from the run's start (the target's start)

fields.name: situation
fields.description: one way of playing the run, one series on screen: real, real B, twin v7, model 2, target

fields.name: source
fields.description: the situation's family: real, sim (every model, twin, replay or prediction) or target; it picks the hue
